notice: Modified by Evnola OU on 2026-11-08: the option --wrap-mode=nodownload is inserted into the meson setup call of scripts/apple/harfbuzz.sh, immediately before --buildtype=release.
reason: HarfBuzz ships subprojects/*.wrap files; without this option meson may download a missing dependency during the build. With it, meson fails instead, so nothing outside the lock is fetched.
